propositions: Type-tier comparability fails to link sibling tickets (task T and story S both children of epic E); the resolver escalates incorrectly to E and rejects the T-S edge entirely.
Redundancy guard is evaluated on the original pair before promotion, missing ancestor-descendant violations in the promoted pair that actually gets written.

Comparability should be structural (nearest common ancestor) rather than type-based, allowing any two tickets under the same parent to link directly and cross-subtree dependencies to escalate to shared ancestor's children.
Virtual-root sentinel ensures every chain terminates consistently, treating parentless tickets as siblings and eliminating undefined disjoint-tree cases.
Ancestor walk with max_hops=2 cap truncates deep chains and feeds fallback logic; uncapping with cycle guard allows correct NCA resolution at any depth.
